text:
alex_chang: Heads-up — ran a pprof/gpu profile on latest runtime w/ model-x64 and saw ~12% GPU memory reduction after enabling tensor pooling prototype. Stripping logs...

maria_k: nice, which buffers are pooled?

alex_chang: activation buffers + logits buffers + small scratchpads. We reuse per-sequence activation slabs across batches and keep a freelist keyed by (dtype, shape class). Implemented LRU eviction when pool > 2x nominal workspace.

kevin_s: how are you sizing the workspace? static vs adaptive?

alex_chang: adaptive. Start with per-model worker baseline = peak from recent live traces (99p), then allow growth up to cap; pool returns are coalesced back into workspace. If OOM on alloc, attempt to shrink pool (drop LRU), then fall back to cudaMalloc with retry.

maria_k: any perf regressions?

alex_chang: small regression on tail latency for very short sequences (~25ms p95 -> 32ms p95) due to extra freelist lookups when pool is cold. But throughput increased ~8% for mixed-length workloads due to fewer cudaMallocs.

lisa_t: can we avoid cold lookups? Maybe warm pool on startup for known shapes.

alex_chang: yes we prefill for top-K shapes per model at startup in the latest patch. Also added fast-path: single-word shape -> direct reuse map to avoid search.

infra-bot: deploybot: canary deployed runtime/tensorpool v0.3 to infra-canary-1

kevin_s: KV cache interaction? any gotchas with pooled KV buffers?

alex_chang: KV cache pages are kept separate (pinned contiguous allocs). We don't pool KV since eviction policy needs strict invalidation. But we introduced a borrow mechanism: if KV free region available, reuse as activation temporary; mandatory restore afterwards.

maria_k: saw an OOM when busy with long context + large batch yesterday. Root cause?

alex_chang: yes. bug in workspace sizing calculation for mixed quantized+fp16 tensors — we underestimated temp logits scratchpad. Fixed: compute worst-case scratchpad per op and add slack factor, plus fallback to cpu spill for logits if GPU mem low.

lisa_t: any telemetry we should add to console?

alex_chang: added per-request metrics: pool_hits, pool_misses, fallback_count, reclaimed_bytes, spill_to_cpu_count. Dashboards are under Runtime->TensorPool.

maria_k: good. plan for next steps?

alex_chang: 1) run 48h canary on production traces, 2) lower default pool cap by 10% to reduce cold p95, 3) add automated warmup for top shapes, 4) stress test mixed quantized models. I'll open a PR with metrics and a patch.

kevin_s: thanks. please tag me and include the pprof snapshot.

alex_chang: will do. attaching quick snippet of pool alloc pseudocode:

```
// simplified
void* alloc(shape, dtype){
  key = shape_class(shape), d = dtype;
  if (freelist[key][d].pop(ptr)) return ptr; // pool hit
  if (workspace.has_space(shape)) return workspace.alloc(shape);
  shrink_pool();
  try cudaMalloc...
}
```

maria_k: :thumbsup:

alex_chang: end of thread — will update with canary metrics tomorrow.
